title.en: An Act Establishing a Public High School in Barangay Lampanusan, Municipality of Kalilangan, Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the Lampanusan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Public High School in Barangay Lampanusan, Municipality of Kalilangan, Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the Lampanusan National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Lampanusan Quốc gia tại Barangay Lampanusan, Đô thị Kalilangan, Tỉnh Bukidnon, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Lampanusan แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Lampanusan เทศบาล Kalilangan จังหวัด Bukidnon และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Lampanusan Nasional di Barangay Lampanusan, Kotamadya Kalilangan, Provinsi Bukidnon, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Lampanusan Kebangsaan di Barangay Lampanusan, Perbandaran Kalilangan, Wilayah Bukidnon, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: A public high school in Barangay Lampanusan, Municipality of Kalilangan, Province of Bukidnon, shall be established under the direct supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports to be known as the Lampanusan National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
